title: Qt: Use a DisplayFilterEdit for custom columns
description:
Custom columns can use any display filter expression, so use
DisplayFilterEdit instead of FieldFilterEdit. The latter is
intended for cases where only a single field can be entered,
like in I/O Graph currently.

FieldFilterEdit right now accepts and produces placeholder text
for entries with more than one word, which is necessary for
supporting the columns but leads to confusion with I/O Graph,
showing invalid entries as Accepted. This switch will allow a
later commit to fix FieldFilterEdit.
